name: Fukuroi Masato
source:
Likes: Mathematical formulas, chemical symbols, going to the library
Dislikes: Ill-mannered people
Hobbies: Doing crossword puzzles, reading

A classmate of [url=/c6508]Kizami[/url] and the student council president of Byakudan Senior High School. He has a stiff and serious personality, but is also surprisingly caring. He complains when Katayama and Ohkawa loaf around the student council room, but easily forgives them for doing so. He used to be bullied back in first grade, but [url=/c11263]Kurosaki[/url] came to his aid. Although he trusts and favours fellow student council member [url=/c11335]Mitsuki[/url], he will not show it openly. Mitsuki’s strict and severe coaching of him is her own way of showing affection.

[From the [url=https://corpseparty.fandom.com/wiki/Masato_Fukuroi]Corpse Party Wiki[/url]]
